description: Business state = owner authority over one exact action. Transport state = what a carrier did with it. They never collapse into one field: a sent booking request is not a confirmed booking, and a green approval never means delivered.

business_transitions.requires: approval record in the same transaction: digest match, fact revision match, trusted owner context, not expired
facts changed or owner withdrew; a new action id is proposed instead
owner revokes before provider acceptance (transport in queued, sending, failed or send_unknown)
dispatch check: monotonic now >= valid_until before provider call
facts changed before provider acceptance; action held for re-approval under a new id

transport_transitions.requires: written in the approval transaction, never separately
worker holds a lease; dispatch attempt recorded BEFORE the provider call; re-checks approval, revocation, expiry, digest and fact revision
proof of non-acceptance (4xx with no message id, connection refused before send)
timeout or ambiguous error after a possible acceptance; ALSO a sending lease found abandoned (process restart, lease expiry). Never requeued blindly.
bounded retry with the SAME idempotency key; attempts < budget; business still approved
idempotent provider status lookup or authenticated callback proves acceptance
provider status lookup proves non-acceptance; never by timeout alone
a delivered receipt arriving before the sent receipt: delivery proves acceptance, so the rank jump is allowed and audited

rules: A receipt whose target rank is lower than the current rank is ignored and audited: receipts never regress a state. A delivered receipt may arrive before sent; it is applied because delivery proves acceptance.
A receipt with a provider event id already seen is ignored. A receipt whose provider reference does not match the recorded one is ignored and audited.

Revoke or cancel is guaranteed only before acceptance. After acceptance the transport state stays sent or delivered; the request is recorded as cancel_requested_after_acceptance and the UI says the send cannot be recalled.

Revocation stops further DISPATCH. It does not freeze carrier truth: an authenticated receipt for an action revoked while sending or send_unknown is still recorded (business revoked, transport sent or delivered), so a late acceptance is never hidden.
send_unknown is never retried blindly. Without a reliable status lookup it is held for the owner. A sending lease found abandoned at restart becomes send_unknown.

Expiry uses a monotonic clock: now_effective = max(wall clock, highest wall clock ever observed). A wall clock behind the high-water mark by more than the tolerance marks the device clock_suspect and holds dispatch; it never extends authority.
New transport activity (queued, dispatch) requires business state approved. Receipts for an action that was once approved are recorded in any later business state.
